# meshes.library: At

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The index-th corner's vertex index. Corners do not wrap: an index
> outside \[0, 3) reads the corner array, which refuses it, so an
> off-by-one is an error instead of a silent read of C.

## Signature

```plato
At(self: TriangleFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
At(self: QuadFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
```

Law_SubstringCharactersAreTheSourceCharacters(s: String, start: Integer, count: Integer): Boolean

### Law_PrefixPrecedesExtension

// A prefix precedes its extension, for the runner's Strings and a character after it.
Law_PrefixPrecedesExtension(s: String, a: Integer): Boolean
    => s < FromCharacters(MapRange(s.Count + 1, i => i < s.Count ? s.At(i) : Code(a).ToCharacter))
    && !(FromCharacters(MapRange(s.Count + 1, i => i < s.Count ? s.At(i) : Code(a).ToCharacter)) <= s);
```

    // The index-th corner's vertex index. Corners do not wrap: an index
    // outside [0, 3) reads the corner array, which refuses it, so an
    // off-by-one is an error instead of a silent read of C.
    At(self: TriangleFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
        => index == 0 ? self.A : (index == 1 ? self.B : (index == 2 ? self.C : self.Vertices[index]));
```

### Line 143

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/meshes.library.plato, line 143](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/meshes.library.plato#L143).

```plato

    // The index-th corner's vertex index. Corners do not wrap: an index
    // outside [0, 4) reads the corner array, which refuses it, so an
    // off-by-one is an error instead of a silent read of D.
    At(self: QuadFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
        => index == 0 ? self.A : (index == 1 ? self.B : (index == 2 ? self.C : (index == 3 ? self.D : self.Vertices[index])));
```
